router_contract: All runtime reviewer lanes use the wrapper-selected local-only checker through http://127.0.0.1:11888/local-agent/v1; ordinary /v1 auto-routing, cloud fallback, and direct-provider fallback are forbidden.

lanes.role_summary: Single router-worker-targeted reviewer prompt combining Gerald Thornton persona and local code/security/test/silent-failure/architecture reviewers, fronted by the deterministic fast prefilter.
Primary strict JSON adversarial code checker; blocks concrete critical/high defects and reports insufficient evidence for incomplete packets.
Shared GitHub PR toolkit code-reviewer profile; high-confidence bugs, quality defects, and project-rule violations.
Shared GitHub silent-failure hunter profile; catches swallowed exceptions, bad fallbacks, and hidden failure paths.
Shared GitHub PR test analyzer profile; focuses on behavioral test coverage, assertion strength, and missing negative cases.
Shared GitHub team-reviewer profile constrained to the testing dimension for structured review coverage.
lanes.profile_instruction: Operate only on the Testing dimension. Ignore accessibility/frontend-only checks unless the reviewed packet is frontend UI code.

lanes.role_summary: Superpowers code-quality review lane. Enabled for additional reviewer perspective on code quality, maintainability, and structural clarity before merge.
lanes.profile_instruction: Act as a Superpowers style reviewer check for code quality, maintainability, and structural clarity.

lanes.role_summary: Datacube Gerald software code reviewer lane requested from RoseStone; do not invoke until contract, resource needs, and routing behavior are known.
